content:
[Thinking]
**Considering customer communication**

The user's request about a "delay courier template" seems a bit vague. I think they’re looking for an email or message template to apologize to a customer about a courier delay. It might be helpful to ask them for more specifics, but I can also prepare a few different templates for various situations. That way, I can ensure they have options to choose from when reaching out to their customers!
[/Thinking]

Here are a few ready‑to‑use templates you can copy, edit, and send, depending on who you’re writing to and how formal you want to be.

---

## 1. Simple apology to customer (email/message)

Subject: Update on Your Delivery

Dear [Customer Name],

I’m writing to let you know that your order (#[Order Number]) is experiencing a delay with our courier.

We understand this is inconvenient and sincerely apologize. We are in contact with the courier to expedite your shipment and will share any updates as soon as we receive them.

Current status: [Brief status, e.g. “Parcel has left the sorting facility and is in transit.”]  
Revised estimated delivery date: [New Date]

If you prefer, we can [offer options: “cancel the order and issue a refund” / “ship a replacement if it does not arrive by [date]” / “offer a discount on this or your next order”].

Thank you for your patience and understanding.  
Kind regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Company Name]  
[Contact Details]

---

## 2. Very short version (WhatsApp/SMS)

Hi [Name], this is [Your Name] from [Company].  
Your order #[Number] is delayed because of a courier issue.  
New estimated delivery: [Date].  
Sorry for the inconvenience – we’re monitoring it closely and will update you if anything changes.

---

## 3. More formal business template

Subject: Courier Delay – Shipment #[Tracking/Order Number]

Dear [Recipient Name],

We regret to inform you that shipment #[Tracking/Order Number], scheduled for delivery on [Original Date], has been delayed due to an issue with our courier partner.

We are actively liaising with the courier to resolve the matter and ensure your goods are delivered as quickly as possible. The revised estimated delivery date is [New Date], subject to courier confirmation.

We apologize for any disruption this may cause to your plans.  
Should this delay significantly impact your operations, please contact us at [Phone/Email] so we can discuss alternative arrangements.

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
[Title]  
[Company Name]  
[Contact Details]

---

## 4. Message to courier company (complaint/urgency)

Subject: Urgent: Delivery Delay – Tracking #[Tracking Number]

Dear [Courier Contact/Support Team],

We are following up regarding a delay on shipment #[Tracking Number], consigned by [Your Company Name] to [Recipient Name] at [Destination].

Details:  
- Pickup date: [Date]  
- Original delivery date: [Date]  
- Current tracking status: [Status from tracking page]  

This delay is now affecting our customer commitments. Please:  
1. Provide a clear status update and cause of delay.  
2. Confirm a new committed delivery date.  
3. Advise any actions required from our side.

We would appreciate your prompt response so we can update our customer accordingly.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Title]  
[Company Name]  
[Account / Customer ID, if any]  
[Phone / Email]

---

If you tell me:
- who you’re sending this to (customer, supplier, courier), and  
- whether it’s email, SMS, or WhatsApp,  
I can tailor one template exactly to your situation and tone.
